text: The Mail Order Queue is the mail team's to-do list. Every order moves through the same steps until it's done.
Open shows every order still in progress.
Each order shows its steps: approval, payment, fill, ship or pickup, check, and contacting the client.
Start each day with cancel requests. Someone asked to stop an order the team already started.
Needs approval is waiting on a doctor. The doctor decides on their task, not here.
Pending client means the ball is in the client's court. We asked them something, and we're waiting on their answer.
Needs payment is waiting on the client to pay.
Fill, ship or pickup, and check are the mail team's work. Oldest first.
Check is a second look. Every prescription needs a licensed vet or technician on the fill or the check. If you're licensed and no one else is here, you can check your own fill, with a reason.
Contacted is the last step: tell the client it's on the way, or ready to pick up.
Search finds any order by number, client, pet or medicine.
The most common mistakes: marking an order pending while waiting on a doctor or manager, and leaving cancel requests waiting.
Remember: cancel requests first, then fill, ship and check, oldest first. Pending is only for the client.
